findings.evidence: return [value for value in left if value in right]
findings.summary: Linear search `value in right` inside list comprehension results in O(N * M) time complexity when right is a list.
findings.suggested_action: Convert `right` to a set before the list comprehension (e.g., `right_set = set(right)`) to achieve O(N + M) average time complexity.

limitations: Benchmark tools and runtime profiling were not executed; time complexity analysis is theoretical.
No explicit style guide or linter configuration was provided.

findings.summary: Tests do not verify cases where elements in `left` are entirely absent from `right`, or non-empty disjoint inputs.
findings.suggested_action: Add unit tests verifying behavior when left and right share no elements (e.g., `overlap_variant([1, 3], [2, 4]) == []`).

limitations: Test coverage tools were not executed; test gap identification is based on manual inspection of supplied tests.
